static_bodies.abi: ECX receiver, signed 32-bit index at entry ESP+4, RET4; signed WORD sign-extended to EAX on admitted indexed path
static_bodies.contract: Read signed runtime count at 00ae2364. If signed index >= count, return zero without reading receiver/table. Otherwise form index*31 modulo 2^32, freshly read receiver first DWORD, then read and sign-extend WORD at table+index*31+12. Negative index is not rejected locally.

static_bodies.abi: ECX receiver, pointer at entry ESP+4, full DWORD flag at entry ESP+8, RET8; ESI/EDI saved; null pointer path clears AX but preserves incoming high EAX half
static_bodies.contract: Null pointer returns with AX zero. Signed *pointer >= runtime count returns 10000 for zero flag, 100 otherwise. Indexed path calls 0062c400, multiplies signed WORDs at table+index*31+10 and +8, forms a signed quotient through the original magic-multiply/shift sequence, applies a signed-DX floor and conditional 9000 cap, then for nonzero flag converts signed AX through x87 (float32 0.01, float64 0.5) and calls 00945640 before a signed-AX upper cap at 100.
limits: callee behavior and x87 control word unvalidated
signed-DX branch tests can differ from full EDX magnitude

scope_limit: Local contracts only; no connected slot or match equivalence
